<!--
Heads-up: this is mostly my personal toolbox, so I'm picky about scope.
Opening an issue first (instead of a surprise PR) means we can agree it fits
before you spend time building it. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->

## What do you want it to do?

<!-- Describe the new object or the improvement. What problem does it solve for a DBA? -->

## How would you call it / use it?

<!-- A rough idea of the interface helps — parameters, what it'd return. -->

```sql
-- EXEC dbo.New_Thing @Param = N'value';
```

## Why does it belong in this repo?

<!-- Is it a general-purpose DBA tool? Does it overlap with something that already exists here or in the OSS toolkits this repo leans on (FRK, Ola, sp_WhoIsActive, Darling Data)? -->

## Would you be up for building it?

<!-- Totally fine if not — just helps me know whether to expect a PR. -->
